claims.claim: All kia and Hyundai genuine spare parts and accessories are available both new and fairly used...
claims.evidence: The witness report only shows a loose car windshield/glass panel with orange trim; no readable brand/model, part number, or proof it is Kia/Hyundai genuine.

risks.risk: Compatibility risk: the windshield may not fit the specific Kia/Hyundai model/year (shape/size/edge profile and mounting points are not shown).
risks.proof: A photo/clip showing the glass part number/markings (etched text) and/or the full windshield edge profile next to a tape measure, plus a shot of the mounting/fitment points.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a generic/unknown-fit windshield glass (worst-case: may not fit), with no guarantee of correct fit.

risks.risk: Condition risk: chips, cracks, scratches, and edge damage are not visible/confirmed in the provided shot.
risks.proof: Close-up clips of all corners and edges, and a bright-light inspection video showing any chips/cracks/scratches on both sides of the glass.
risks.if_unproven: Price as potentially damaged/used with unknown condition (worst-case: treat as not ideal for resale/installation).

risks.risk: Completeness risk: it may be missing seals, brackets, mounting hardware, or trim pieces (only an orange trim strip is visible).
risks.proof: A full-layout photo showing the entire windshield assembly/trim, and a checklist photo of any included seals/brackets/hardware.
risks.if_unproven: Price as glass-only (no hardware/seals/complete trim), worst-case requiring extra parts to install.

risks.risk: Type/markings risk: tempered vs laminated, and any safety markings/part numbers are not readable, affecting suitability and legality for replacement.
risks.proof: A clear close-up of any markings/labels on the glass (part number, DOT/E-mark, laminated/tempered indicators).
risks.if_unproven: Price as unknown glass type/unknown markings (worst-case: may not meet required spec).

risks.risk: Brand/model identification risk: no branding is readable, so the seller’s Kia/Hyundai “genuine” claim cannot be tied to this exact glass.
risks.proof: A photo of the etched manufacturer/brand markings or part number that can be cross-referenced to Kia/Hyundai.
risks.if_unproven: Price as non-verified origin (worst-case: not confirmed genuine).

proof_requests: Send a close-up photo of any etched/printed part number and safety markings on the glass (both sides).
Send a photo with a tape measure showing the windshield dimensions and the full edge/trim profile.
Send close-ups of all corners and edges under bright light to confirm there are no chips/cracks/scratches.
Confirm whether seals, brackets, mounting hardware, and the full trim set are included (photos of what’s in the package).
Provide the exact Kia/Hyundai model/year it fits (and a photo of the part number label that matches that fitment).
response.reason: The witness confirms it is a car windshield/glass panel with orange trim, but key pricing drivers—fitment, condition, completeness, and markings—are not verifiable from the single image. Without those, a worst-case price would be too speculative.
